title: Adidas x Bad Bunny "F50 Ghost Sprint" Pack Closes Out With "Charcoal" Colorway, Set for Fall 2026
detail: Adidas and Bad Bunny reveal the third and final colorway of the F50 Ghost Sprint pack, "Charcoal" (Core Black/Charcoal-Aurora Black, style code HP4218), priced at $160 and slated for a Fall 2026 release via adidas.com and select retailers. The neutral grey-toned pair closes out the three-colorway F50 Ghost Sprint run — following "Dark Marine" and "Solar Slime" — that launched alongside Bad Bunny's Adidas FIFA World Cup 2026 campaign.
